sources.ref: Walkplay Android app 2.3.1 (com.ttgk.musicbox): its product catalog (data/catalogs/walkplay.json) lists 0x3302:0x39c1 "ES9039" under scheme 15; band count, filter types and Q and pre-gain limits as the app's editor gives them for that scheme

meta.notes:
devicePEQ marks this device experimental.
devicePEQ gives this device 8 bands of peaking and shelf filters; Walkplay's app gives scheme 15 the same 8 bands with low pass and high pass filters too. Its Q and pre-gain limits are those of Walkplay's web app, read back from a scheme 11 device: Q up to 10, as in devicePEQ, and a pre-gain of -16 to +6 dB in whole dB (devicePEQ: -128 to +127); not checked on this device.
The scheme was found by product name: the profile carries no product id, and the catalog row 0x3302:0x39c1 names the product "ES9039", without the trailing space of this profile's product name.
